title: The Hamburger Criterion for Matrix Nevanlinna--Pick Interpolation
summary: The classical Hamburger moment problem can be viewed as an interpolation problem for Nevanlinna functions. A closely related problem is the Nevanlinna--Pick interpolation problem. Each of these problems is either determinate, with a unique solution, or indeterminate, with infinitely many solutions. Hamburger established a criterion for the indeterminacy of the moment problem in terms of the convergence of two series involving the classical polynomials of the first and second kind.
